title: Magazine p. 43: McDivitt case conclusion and Gemini-7 "force field" UFO photo discussion
description: Photocopied magazine page of article text with a largely washed-out photograph (numbered 7) in the lower right showing only a faint mark. The text covers NASA's and NORAD's views on the McDivitt case, the Condon report, and a widely circulated Gemini-7 photo of "two very strange glowing objects" that the author calls "a forgery" and "a hoax." A handwritten annotation reads "see plates 27 & 28."
